name: Üso Ewin
source:
From: Mobile Suit V Gundam
A civilian boy who grew up at Earth's Point Kasarelia. During the invasion of Europe by the Zanscare Empire Forces (or BESPA), he was wrapped up in the war and would end up falling in with the League Militaire.
